mapper.select: select * from sp_encoding_parameters where id = #{encodingParametersId} and lv = '0';
SELECT * FROM sp_encoding_parameters WHERE encoding_id = #{encodingId} and code = #{code};

WITH RECURSIVE sub_tree AS ( -- 基础层级：找到 lv=0 的记录 SELECT * FROM sp_encoding_parameters WHERE lv = '0' AND id = #{id} -- 参数：lv=0 的记录 ID
UNION ALL
-- 递归层级：查找子记录 SELECT ep.* FROM sp_encoding_parameters ep INNER JOIN sub_tree st ON ep.pid = st.id WHERE ep.lv IN ('1', '2', '3', '4') -- 限制层级 ) SELECT * FROM sub_tree WHERE lv != '0' -- 排除根节点本身 ORDER BY lv ASC, code ASC; -- 按 lv 和 code 排序
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sp_encoding_parameters (id, pid, encoding_id, code, name, lv, encoding_status, version,category,modify_user, modify_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{pid}, #{encodingId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{lv}, #{encodingStatus},#{version},#{category,typeHandler=org.springblade.modules.sp.utils.VarcharArrayTypeHandler}, #{modifyUser}, #{modifyTime});

INSERT INTO sp_encoding_parameters (id, pid, encoding_id, code, name, lv, encoding_status, version,category,modify_user, modify_time) VALUES

mapper.update: UPDATE sp_encoding_parameters set encoding_status = '1' where encoding_id = #{encodingId};
